description: LoomaScale helps users inspect connected Google and Meta ad accounts, review campaign performance and pacing, research keywords and search terms, create paused campaigns, and manage campaign delivery and budgets. Activating a campaign starts real ad spend; every create, activation, and budget change is validated against a user-configured daily spend cap.

defaultPrompt: Find wasted spend in my Google Ads search terms and block it.
Launch a Google Search campaign for my product and set the budget.
Show all my Google and Meta campaigns and their performance.
